_provenance: Hand-authored by a Claude subagent from the pilot prose alone, blind to any translator output, 2026-09-23.

rules.condition: Is self's hp below 25% of max hp?

criteria.true: critically hurt, retreat is the whole point of existing

rules.condition: Is an enemy bearbot close enough to touch (short/melee range) with Kick off cooldown?

criteria.true: reflex taunt/knockback, no hesitation, no overthinking

rules.condition: Is an enemy bearbot near one of my allies (not necessarily near me)?

criteria.true: that enemy is now my problem

rules.condition: Are two or more enemies bunched together near me, with Fill off cooldown?

criteria.true: drop the AoE slow under their feet, not mine
criteria.false: no cluster near me worth an AoE

rules.condition: Is an enemy bearbot close enough that a fight is actually happening (not merely visible far across the map)?

criteria.true: the fight is the lane now — attack the nearest enemy bearbot
criteria.false: nothing close enough to count as engaged
